Yaaha Inc. is a creative company that specializes in short-form video advertising to support the marketing efforts of partner companies. We have built a track record primarily in the production and operation of vertical short-form video ads, having supported over 300 companies to date.
In this article, we will introduce the strengths and future prospects of the advertising operation agency business developed by Yaaha. Please take a look to deepen your understanding of Yaaha.

Yaaha specializes in short-form video ads such as those on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Short-form videos that use the full vertical screen are a form of advertising that has been gaining rapid attention in recent years because they are easy for users to notice and have a high potential to attract interest.

Specifically, by displaying short videos lasting from a few seconds to over ten seconds in a way that blends naturally into the feeds of apps and social media, we create moments where users feel "curious" or "this looks interesting."
